description: Sign the user up for an email reminder before EVERY upcoming match of a football team. Matches added or moved later are covered too, so the user never has to come back. Use it when the user says every match, all matches, whenever <team> plays, or follow <team>; for one match, use remind_me. Ask the user for their email address first (never guess it). A new address gets one confirmation email, and the reminders start once the user clicks the link in it. Every reminder has a link to stop following. Only for teams, never for personal appointments. When beep.me is connected with sign-in, leave email out: it is on at once, with no confirmation email.

country.description: Optional two-letter country code of the user.

email.description: The user's own email address, exactly as they gave it. Leave it out when beep.me is connected with sign-in: the signed-in account's own address is used.

language.description: Language for the emails: 'no' for Norwegian, 'en' for English (default).

remind_before_minutes.description: Optional. How many minutes before the start the email should arrive, when the user said so: 30 for «half an hour before», 1440 for «a day before». Leave it out to use the event's own time.

team.description: The team as people write it: 'Manchester United', 'Bodø/Glimt', 'Real Madrid'.

timezone.description: Optional IANA time zone of the user, e.g. 'Europe/Oslo', so the email shows their local time.

name: follow_team
title: Email me before every match of a team
